# Nonogram Break by ARLing

> One free, playable 8×8 sample from an existing printable nonogram book. No account or subscription.

- [Play the sample](https://arling.sk/nonogram-break/): mark squares manually, undo a stroke, reset, or check your marks. Empty crosses are optional for completion. A separate guided mode explains all 19 logical steps. Progress is kept when switching modes within this page; refreshing starts over.
- [Download the free PDF sample](https://arling.sk/nonogram-break/sample.pdf): a printable preview, not the full paid book.
- [The 50-puzzle book](https://arling.sk/puzzle-books/nonogram-puzzle-book-50-printable-logic-puzzles/): 50 abstract nonograms, 13 easy, 15 medium, 15 hard, 7 challenge; rules, an example with its answer, and all solutions. Two PDF files, A4 and US Letter, each 62 pages, containing the same puzzles.
- [Buy on Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/listing/4574163338): listing price EUR 2.90; Etsy displays discounts and applicable local tax before payment. Digital download only, nothing shipped.
- [Privacy](https://arling.sk/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://arling.sk/podmienky/)

This is one book sample, not an unlimited standalone game. The listing scene uses AI-generated imagery; the puzzle page is real. Existing cookie-free analytics measure visits and actions. A checkout click is not a sale.
